storyParagraphs: We have seen how many students, despite great effort, don't get the support they truly need.

Too often, structure is missing.
Too often, motivation is missing.
Too often, tutoring is treated only as a short-term fix.
Learning should be understandable, modern and motivating.
Today we support students with personal guidance, digital learning materials and clear learning systems to help them achieve better results.

adminDashboard.accessGuideIntro: How to review the frontend, user flows, and website content:
accessGuideSteps: Public website at www.nextgrades.at — marketing pages in German.
Student and teacher login at /login (accounts are created by admins).
Admin portal at /portal/login with your administrator account.
Website content (CMS): Admin portal → Edit website content — edit copy, images, team, FAQs, and testimonials.
New users: Admin portal → Users → New user — invitation email with password setup link.
